Str_EnableSoundEffects: Play subtle sounds on popup and action
Str_AutoCopyOnSelection: Automatically read selected text on drag (required for instant LLM actions)
Str_HotkeyDescription: Trigger the popup for the currently selected text using a hotkey. Select modifiers, then click the key field and press a key.
Str_HotkeyKeyboxTooltip: Click here, then press a key. Delete/Backspace to clear.
Str_PopupTriggerHint: Popup triggers: drag to select · double-click (word) · Shift+arrow keys / Ctrl+A · hold left button (≥ 300 ms) in a text field · custom hotkey above. Dismiss with Esc, right-click, or clicking outside.
Str_ActionReplaceTooltip: Replace selected text with AI result
Str_ActionPopupTooltip: Show AI result in a popup window
Str_ActionBrowserTooltip: Open Google search with selected text (no AI)
Str_ActionDirectCopyTooltip: Copy selected text to clipboard (no AI)
Str_ActionPasteTooltip: Paste clipboard content at cursor (no AI)
Str_ActionDeleteTooltip: Delete selected text without touching clipboard (no AI)
Str_ActionSimulateKeyTooltip: Press a key at cursor — set key name in Prompt: Enter, Space, Delete, Backspace, Escape, Tab (no AI)
Str_ActionSelectAllTooltip: Select all text in the focused field, then re-show the action bar (no AI)
Str_CleanOutputTooltip: Instructs the AI to return only the result, without any explanation or preamble.
Str_SettingsRecoveryMsg:
Your settings file was corrupted and has been reset to defaults.

A backup of the corrupted file was saved with a .bak extension.
Str_HookErrorMsg:
Failed to install global mouse hook (Error code: {0}).

Orbital requires this hook to detect text selection gestures.
The application will now exit.

Common causes:
- Insufficient permissions
- Conflicting software (security tools, other hook-based apps)
- System resource limitations
Str_UpdateBalloonMsg: Version {0} has been downloaded. Restart Orbital to apply.
Str_InvalidApiConfigMsg:
Invalid API configuration: {0}

Please check your settings.
Str_ImportModeMsg:
Replace existing actions or merge with current actions?

Yes = Replace all existing actions
No = Merge (skip duplicates by name)
Cancel = Abort import
Str_ImportSuccessReplace: Action pack imported successfully. All previous actions were replaced.
Str_ImportSuccessMerge: Action pack imported successfully. New actions were merged with existing ones.
